doc.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth in East Harlem and his parents' names
summary: Palmieri gives his birth name, date and place, then names his parents, both born in Ponce, Puerto Rico.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I’d like to start from the beginning. If you could start with giving your full birth-name, birth-place, and birth-date.
Well, Edward Palmieri. I was born in 60 East 112th Street in Manhattan, known as
the barrio, and at about 5 or 6 years old... That was 1936.
December 15th. A Sagittarius all the way.
And my parents then moved to the Bronx...
Before we get to that, can we talk about your parents’ full names, and where they originally came from.

Oh, of course. My mother was Isabel Maldonado... Well, they called it Isabel Palmieri Maldonado; they gave the second name, the maiden name last. My father, Carlos Manuel Palmieri. They were both born in Ponce, Puerto Rico.
